adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, when the parsed data lacks `refresh_token`, it forcibly sets `refresh_token` to the literal string "refresh_token" (`if (!refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token) { refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"; }`). In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refreshed token data is merged into the existing stored credentials via `o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) };` and then persisted. If Microsoft’s refresh response omits `refresh_token` (common behavior), this merge will overwrite the real stored refresh token with the placeholder, breaking future refreshes. (The GoogleCalendar path does not demonstrate the same overwrite because it parses `googleCredentials` which already includes a refresh token, but the Office365 overwrite is clearly verifiable from the diff.)
